caption: 🥞 Save this easy toddler-friendly breakfast! This blueberry banana skillet pancake is made with simple pantry ingredients and is perfect for the whole family. We top ours with a little maple syrup, and our toddler enjoys hers plain. 💙 ✨ Ingredients: • 1 ripe banana • 1/3 cup all-purpose flour • 1/2 tsp baking powder • 1 egg • Dash of cinnamon (optional) • Small handful of blueberries, cut in half or lightly smashed • Unsalted butter for the pan Directions: 🥞 Mash the banana, then mix in the flour, baking powder, egg, and cinnamon. Fold in the blueberries. Butter a skillet and cook over low-medium heat until bubbles form on top, then flip and cook until both sides are golden brown. Let cool before serving.
